content.comment_body: Hi, I'm new to this. I need advice on what to buy to set up engine alarms for my ship. I want to read two PT100 sensors and three pressure transmitters (4-20 mA). Which components should I get?

Hello, What type of power supply do you have on the ship? Is it 12V or 24V? This info is important to give the correct advice. If you already use a [product_name], please share the full type number. Would you like to display alarms on a [product_name] operator device, an HMI panel, or just use warning lamps? Regards,

24 volts supply. Using a [product_name] operator device would be nice, but it's not essential. I need an alarm for water pressure, oil pressure—both pre-alarm and main alarm—and the engine must shut down on the main alarm. Is it possible to use just one pressure transmitter for this?

It's best to use a 24V DC [product_name]. You can use one analog input for pressure as many times as needed in your program. Handling three signals on one analog input is possible. For the PT100 sensors, you'll require an expansion module: [product_name] [article_no]—only 12 or 24V DC power is supported. You can connect two PT100 sensors to this module. For more documentation, see: [url]

Hello, To read your pressure sensors, you could use a [product_name] with onboard analog inputs, such as [article_no]. The issue is that the module only supports 0-10V analog inputs, but you can use a 500-ohm resistor to adapt a 4-20mA signal. You can also use external switching to make a 0-10V analog input work for 0-20mA signals. Connection examples from other controllers may apply here also. To use the full range of your sensors, signal converters (4-20mA to 0-10V) are needed. For temperature readings, use the module mentioned in the previous post. Regards,
Thanks for the quick replies. Is there a module available that can directly read 4-20mA sensors?
Hello, There is a module that supports 0 to 20mA signals, which works with 4-20mA as well. Look for [product_name] [article_no] expansion module. Regards,
Thanks everyone, you’ve been very helpful! I’m going to buy the components and test them out. If I need more assistance, I’ll be back.
I also need to measure engine RPM with a magnetic pick-up. Which one should I use?
Hello, The choice depends on the maximum switching speed you need. The high-speed inputs of [product_name] can handle signals up to 5kHz. Regards,
Hello, You can use an inductive sensor to detect a metal part. I’ve attached an example (not [company_name]). Visit their website to choose a suitable option. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: A beginner is seeking advice on setting up engine alarms for ship engines using [company_name] automation products. There's uncertainty about which modules support direct 4-20mA sensor inputs and which expansion modules are needed for PT100 temperature sensors. The discussion highlights the modular nature of the product range and includes recommendations for adapting sensor signals using accessories, but also reveals that the product ecosystem could be confusing for new users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a clear step-by-step guide to selecting compatible [company_name] modules for connecting specific sensors and implementing alarm functions, preferring options that allow seamless integration with minimal additional hardware.
